analysis.summary: Maxvolt Energy Industries Limited reported H2 FY26 revenue of INR166.7 crores, with full-year FY26 revenue growing by 176% year-on-year to INR296.7 crores. EBITDA for H2 FY26 reached INR17.2 crores with an EBITDA margin of 10.3%, while PAT stood at INR11.5 crores with a PAT margin of 6.9%. Management highlighted capacity expansion across two production facilities to 14,000+ batteries per month, ongoing development of the Aligarh lithium battery recycling plant, and a strategic focus on expanding presence in the three-wheeler and energy storage systems (ESS) segments. MaxVolt Energy Industries Limited reported an increase in operational performance for H2 FY26 and FY26, highlighting growth in revenue, production capacity, and manufacturing footprint. The company expanded its network, advanced its R&D and recycling initiatives through its subsidiary MaxVolt ReEarth, and maintained various product certifications.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 50%, 60%, or 70% growth rate around forward revenues.
guidance.quote: And in terms of the forward I can say the forward revenues, you will see a substantial growth, and we can say like a 50%, 60%, 70% growth you will see around.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 5% market share in India.
The company targets a 5% share in India's lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.
guidance.quote: Targeting 5% share in India’s lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.

guidance.claim: Maxvolt aims to capture around 5% of the Indian recycling market by FY32.
guidance.quote: and Maxvolt aims to capture around 5% of the market by FY32, contributing to over 12,000 tons of annual CO2 reduction through circular operations.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 5% market share by 2032.
Management targets achieving approximately 5% market share by 2032.
guidance.quote: So, 5% by 2032, we are planning to have a 5% market share.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the e-scooter segment delivered revenue of INR217 crores, contributing 73.1% of total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: Delivering a revenue of INR217 crores, contributing 73.1% of total revenue and registering a robust growth of 147.6% year-on-year growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The e-rickshaw segment grew exponentially with revenue of INR22 crores, contributing 7.4% of total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: Our e-rickshaw segment has emerged to the fastest-growing vertical, delivering revenue of INR22 crores and contributing 7.4% of total revenue with exponential growth of 5,564.3%.

demand_outlook.claim: The energy storage ESS segment delivered INR21.4 crores in revenue, contributing 7.2% to total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: Our energy storage, ESS segment delivered revenue of about INR21.4 crores, contributing 7.2% to total revenue that is registering a strong growth of 537.4%, reflecting growing demand in sustainable energy storage solutions.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is projected to rise from 3 GWh in 2022 to 70 GWh by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand to rise from 3 GWh (2022) to 70 GWh (2030); annual market could exceed $15 Bn by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted surging revenue driven by strong demand and operational excellence.
demand_outlook.quote: During the first half of FY '26, we are proud to show that we have delivered a phenomenal performance with revenue, surging by 222.9% year-on-year to INR 130 crores, driven by strong demand, capacity expansion and operation excellence.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian lithium ion battery market is projected to grow to $9.6 billion by 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we will remain aligned with the rapid expansion of India's lithium ion battery market, projected to grow from $3.2 billion in 2024 to $9.6 billion by 2033, at a CAGR of around 12%.

demand_outlook.claim: The global lithium market is expected to reach $320 billion by 2030 with the recycling segment surpassing $25 billion.
demand_outlook.quote: Globally, the lithium market is expected to reach $320 billion by 2030, with the recycling segment surpassing $25 billion.

demand_outlook.claim: Within India, the recycling opportunity is estimated at $1.2 to $1.5 billion annually by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Within India, the recycling opportunity alone is estimated at $1.2 to $1.5 billion annually by 2030, and Maxvolt aims to capture around 5% of the market by FY32, contributing to over 12,000 tons of annual CO2 reduction through circular operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated project cost for the Aligarh plant is about INR282 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: That overall plant cost, estimated cost is the project cost is about INR282 crores and including construction, including machines, laboratory, pilot line, crushing plant, and the industrial scale what we are expecting and planning right now.

capex_expansion.claim: The current phase operational leads capacity to somewhere around 500 megawatt-hour, aiming for around 2 gigawatt-hour when complete.
capex_expansion.quote: So, basically, the current phase that we have made operational it leads our capacity to somewhere around 500 megawatt-hour. Once the complete plant is operational, so the whole capacity is going to be around like 2 gigawatt-hour.

capex_expansion.claim: MaxVolt has a newly commissioned 55,000 sq. ft. facility alongside its existing Ghaziabad plant.
capex_expansion.quote: With an installed capacity of 600 -750 MWh (depending on product type) including a newly commissioned 55,000 sq. ft. facility alongside our existing Ghaziabad plant, we are steadily expanding production capacity and evaluating new sites for further scale.

capex_expansion.claim: A new 55,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility was commissioned in Ghaziabad during H1 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: A key milestone in H1 FY '26 was the commissioning of a new 55,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Ghaziabad, which doubled our production capacity from 6,000 to 12,500 battery packs per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been allotted by the UP MSME Department for the Aligarh recycling plant under Phase-1.
capex_expansion.quote: Under Phase-1, that is crushing and black mass generation, the land has been allotted by the UP MSME Department for our Aligarh recycling plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The Aligarh recycling plant will commence operation in FY26-27 with an initial capacity of 7,800 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: This plant will commence operation in FY '26-'27, with an initial capacity of 7,800 metric tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase-2 metal extraction and refining unit is targeted for FY28-29.
capex_expansion.quote: For Phase-2, metal extraction and refining was being developed in parallel, with an advanced extraction unit targeted for FY '28-'29, focused on recovering metals like nickel, cobalt, manganese and lithium.

capex_expansion.claim: The second phase capacity expansion is targeted for August 2026 to reach 25,000 batteries.
capex_expansion.quote: And in the second phase, we will take it to 25,000. And we are targeting the second phase, like the first phase, which has already been working and operational by January. And in the second phase, which we are targeting is somewhere around August 2026, for which we will have the number of 25,000 batteries.

margins_costs.claim: For H2 FY26, EBITDA stood at INR17.2 crores with an EBITDA margin of 10.3%.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA stood at INR17.2 crores, marking a year-on-year growth increase of 101% with an EBITDA margin of 10.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax (PAT) for H2 FY26 came to an end at INR11.5 crores with a PAT margin of 6.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax, our PAT came to an end at INR11.5 crores, reflecting year-on-year growth of 115% with a PAT margin of 6.9%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the black mass shredding and separation plant are expected to be around 18% to 20%.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of EBITDA is about 18% to 20% approximate.

margins_costs.claim: The gross profit margin was 17.9% in H2 FY26 compared to 19.6% in H2 FY25.
The EBITDA margin was 10.3% in H2 FY26 compared to 12.7% in H2 FY25.
The PAT margin was 6.9% in H2 FY26 compared to 7.9% in H2 FY25.
EBITDA margin stood at 14.2% for the first half of FY26.
Profit after tax margin was reported at 9.9% for H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profit after tax, our PAT value, come in at INR 1,292 lakhs, reflecting year-on-year growth of about 171%, with the PAT margin of 9.9%.

margins_costs.claim: The crushing plant is expected to generate margins around 30% to 35%.
margins_costs.quote: And in terms of just the roughly numbers, we will be doing around 30% to 35% of the margins in there.

margins_costs.claim: Current EBITDA for the crushing plant is approximately 22% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA is like 22% to 25% approximate.

orders_capacity.claim: Maxvolt established its presence across 16 states, supported by 12 warehouses, 875 plus dealers and distributors, and 31 plus OEM clients.
orders_capacity.quote: We have now established our presence across 16 states, supported by 12 warehouses, 875 plus dealers and distributors. And 31 plus OEM clients across electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, EPC and customized battery applications.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing infrastructure scales through two production facilities with a monthly production capacity exceeding 14,000 plus batteries.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing infrastructure continues to scale through two production facilities with a monthly production capacity exceeding 14,000 plus batteries, while our service and reverse logistics network extends across more than 1,300 pin codes nationwide.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated they are running with an order book more than 150% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Surely, we already running we already have an order book, which is more than 150% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 600 - 750 MWh depending on the product type.
orders_capacity.quote: With an installed capacity of 600 -750 MWh (depending on product type) including a newly commissioned 55,000 sq. ft. facility alongside our existing Ghaziabad plant, we are steadily expanding production capacity and evaluating new sites for further scale.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed 14,000+ batteries monthly production capacity.
The dealer and distributor network has grown to 875+ partners.
The new manufacturing facility doubled production capacity from 6,000 to 12,500 battery packs per month.
orders_capacity.quote: A key milestone in H1 FY '26 was the commissioning of a new 55,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Ghaziabad, which doubled our production capacity from 6,000 to 12,500 battery packs per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity in FY25 was 97.2 megawatt hour and increased to 130 megawatt hour in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, if you look into FY '25, our capacity is 97.2 megawatt hour. This year our capacity is 130 megawatt hour.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exchange fluctuations, rising dollar pricing, and stretched raw material supply chains impacted EBITDA and PAT slightly.
risks_headwinds.quote: The dollar pricing is increasing; the raw material supply chain is a bit having a stretch on it. So, bit of the issue of the supply chain and the costing impact, the thing is going to have a minor impact.

risks_headwinds.claim: India faces a lack of domestic lithium, cobalt, and nickel reserves.
risks_headwinds.quote: Lacks domestic lithium, cobalt, nickel reserves.

risks_headwinds.claim: India faces capital, talent, and recycling infrastructure gaps.
risks_headwinds.quote: Faces capital, talent, and recycling infrastructure gaps.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that cash flow is a bit of a challenge due to aggressive expansion and project deployment.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, I believe cash flow is a bit of a challenge, because every time we need an infusion for that because initially our target is bigger.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects full-fledged 2.2 to 2.5-gigawatt capacity post the commissioning of the entire machines, targeting production start in December 2026 or January 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Hopefully, the coming new calendar year, in year '27, we are hoping to get the start production December and January, December '26 or maximum January '27.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 of the manufacturing plant is expected to be operational by October-November of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, everything is going on. So, the wiring and everything, the load enhancement everything is in process and machines is also ordered somewhere. So, we -- so you can expect it to be operational by October-November of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a 5% share in India's lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting 5% share in India’s lithium recycling and battery pack manufacturing by FY2032.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of the Aligarh recycling plant is scheduled to begin by March 2026.
management_commitments.quote: With construction scheduled to begin by March 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The recycling plant will commence operation in FY26-27.
management_commitments.quote: This plant will commence operation in FY '26-'27, with an initial capacity of 7,800 metric tons per annum.

management_commitments.claim: An advanced extraction unit for Phase-2 is targeted for FY28-29.
management_commitments.quote: For Phase-2, metal extraction and refining was being developed in parallel, with an advanced extraction unit targeted for FY '28-'29, focused on recovering metals like nickel, cobalt, manganese and lithium.

management_commitments.claim: The additional 6,500 battery capacity is expected to be 100% commissioned by the end of December.
management_commitments.quote: We have already proceeded the 100% commissioned by what I believe is the end of December. I believe, we are getting the 100% commissioned by December.

management_commitments.claim: The second phase capacity expansion is targeted around August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: And in the second phase, which we are targeting is somewhere around August 2026, for which we will have the number of 25,000 batteries.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
